invariants.rule: pages.length + items.length must be at most 500.
Page, collection, and item IDs must be globally unique.
Page routes, collection list routes, and collection item detail routes must be unique.
Field IDs must be unique within each collection.
Category IDs and slugs must each be unique within their category field.
A collection excerptSourceFieldId, when present, must reference a text field.
Content collections cannot use masonry; gallery collections cannot use list layout.
Every item must reference an existing collection.
Items in content collections must have a non-empty title.
A published gallery item must have at least one image in a gallery field.
Items with automatic descriptions require the collection text excerpt source field.
Every item value key must reference a field in its collection.
Each item value must match its field type and field limits; category values must reference categories defined by that field.
Every collectionView block must reference an existing collection.
A collectionView filter must reference a category field in that collection and categories defined by that field.
Link values allow local absolute paths or http, https, mailto, and tel URLs; reject protocol-relative paths and other schemes.
Heading blocks require a level; paragraph blocks must not have one.
Rich text has at most 1,500,000 text characters and 33,000 images; text marks cannot repeat.
